home.title: Where did this food come from?
home.lead: Scan the code on your pack to see where it was grown, how it was handled, and the proof each party signed.
home.scanHint: Open your phone camera and point it at the QR code on the pack. It opens this site on the right page.
home.entryLabel: Or type the 18-digit number printed under the code
home.invalid: That is not a valid lot number. Check the 18 digits printed under the QR code and try again.
home.stepsTitle: How a pack gets its record

steps.title: Farm
steps.body: The farmer confirms the lot on their own phone. The village and harvest date are recorded.

steps.title: Collection centre
steps.body: The lot is weighed and graded on signed readings, then stored cold.

steps.title: You
steps.body: Each handover is recorded. You can open the proofs and check them yourself.

home.privacy: This page never shows the name or phone number of any farmer.

lot.ledgerLink: See the record on the ledger explorer
lot.indexOnly: Showing the last verified record. Live ledger node is offline.
lot.residueYesWhy: A residue test result for this lot is recorded on the ledger. The result itself is not changed once it is written.
lot.residueNoWhy: The ledger holds no residue test for this lot. We do not claim one.
lot.phiYesWhy: The farmer logs every spray in a diary. The gap between the last spray and the harvest was long enough for the product used. The diary itself is private and is not shown here.
lot.phiNoWhy: The record could not confirm that the wait after the last spray was long enough. The diary itself is private and is not shown here.
lot.coldYesWhy: A temperature logger travelled with the lot. It recorded no reading outside the allowed range, and its summary is anchored on the ledger.
lot.coldNo: Not kept cool all the way
lot.coldNoWhy: The temperature logger recorded a reading outside the allowed range during storage or transport. Breaches recorded: {count}. We show this as it was recorded.

steps.Lot commissioned with the farmer signatu: Lot registered with the farmer's own confirmation
steps.Graded and weighed on a signed weighbrid: Graded and weighed on a signed weighbridge

lot.verifyBody: Four organisations keep copies of this record. Changing it would need several of them to collude. Each line below is one entry. Open it in the ledger explorer to see which organisations signed it.

channelOrgs.trace-channel: producer company, bank, buyer, district monitoring cell
channelOrgs.finance-channel: producer company, bank, district monitoring cell

lot.noProofs: No ledger entries are listed for this lot yet.
lot.simulated: Simulated: payments, e-NWR and other outside systems. The ledger entries are real.

notFound.title: We cannot find this lot
notFound.body: No record matches {sscc}. Check the 18 digits under the QR code. If the number is right and the pack still shows nothing, the label may not be genuine.
notFound.bad: {sscc} is not a valid lot number.

unreachable.title: The record cannot be reached right now
unreachable.body: Neither the live ledger node nor the saved copy answered. Try again in a minute.
